description: Dataset for: Monitoring and repair of isolated trackbed defects on a ballasted railway is a data set deposited in University of Southampton Repository by its authors David Milne. This dataset contains track stiffness and deflection data to accompany:Le Pen, L., Milne, D., Powrie, W., Watson, G., Thompson, D., Hayward, M., & Morley, S. (2018) 'Monitoring and repair of isolated trackbed defects on a ballasted railway', Transportation GeotechnicsPlease see read me. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
